Q3 retrospective notes

Draft saved 2 minutes ago. Shipping updates went out on time this quarter and the on-call load dropped by a third after the alert cleanup.

content.text:
## Summary

**Defects found:**
1. The three action controls (`Save draft`, `Share`, `Discard`) were `<div class="btn">` elements with click handlers but no semantics, no tabindex, and no keyboard activation — they were completely unreachable and unusable from the keyboard, and screen readers had no way to know they were buttons.
2. No guaranteed visible focus indicator was defined for the actions.
3. The `#status` paragraph updates dynamically (e.g. "Draft saved.") but wasn't announced to assistive technology (WCAG 4.1.3 Status Messages).

**Fixes:**
- Converted the three `.btn` divs to real `<button type="button">` elements, keeping their `class`, `id`s (none existed to lose) and `data-track` attributes untouched, so the existing instrumentation script and the click handlers in the second `<script>` block continue to work unchanged. Native `<button>` gives Tab reachability plus built-in Enter/Space activation for free — no custom key handling needed, and the mouse and keyboard paths stay identical since both fire the same native `click` event that the tracker listens for.
- Reset `border`, `font-family`, and `line-height` on `.btn` so the buttons render pixel-identical to the old divs (same padding, radius, colors, font-weight).
- Added an explicit `:focus-visible` outline (`2px solid #1a4fd6` with offset) so all three actions have a clear, consistent visible focus indicator regardless of browser/theme defaults.
- Added `role="status" aria-live="polite"` to the `#status` message element so save/share/discard confirmations are announced to screen reader users without moving focus.

**Left alone:**
- Color palette — checked contrast ratios for all three button variants (primary ~6.1:1, neutral ~13.3:1, danger ~6.1:1 against their backgrounds); all already exceed the 4.5:1 AA text threshold, so no palette changes were needed.
- Overall layout, visual hierarchy, and the instrumentation script were not touched.
- No dialogs or composite widgets exist on this page, so no ARIA pattern/focus-trap work was needed beyond the button fix above.
